label: AUTHORITATIVE
verdict: NO CHANGE (<50ms per failing tool call)

harness.note: Installed bundle lib and host Cordis copied dereferenced into scratch; zero symlinks in the harness. All imported entries are inside the scratch harness and runtime is only an executable input.

measurementNotes: The narrow window is only between two parent-process observation points and does not prove coverage of a collector commit; the full session/prompt -> JSON-RPC response window is the coverage proof.
Paired results report median, medianAbsDiff and signed direction counts; no claim is made that an effect is smaller than the A/A noise.
In-process harness loads the installed bundle from --home with the host Cordis resolved from --runtime; any fallback is recorded in harness.fallback and degrades evidence quality.
The in-process first commit includes lazy SQL statement preparation; steady percentiles exclude it.
The real collector defers degradation writes to agent/turn-stopping: toolsResultOnly and turnStoppingOnly are timed separately, with the +1 event required at turn-stopping.
Every child process receives TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP from the validated scratch; the only child here is the ACP host (there is no execFileSync attribution probe).
The fsync comparison is attribution only on an isolated database; NORMAL weakens durability and is not a proposed change.
Every accepted sample is gated by a real store.stats() delta; rejected samples are counted and fail the run.

failure.description: tools/result isError=true; one BEGIN IMMEDIATE/COMMIT per emit

cleanSuccess.description: clean read; in-memory counters only, zero writes

positiveControl.description: a known failing emit before and after the batch must each commit exactly one event

degradation.description: read with TRUNCATED_LINE; real collector defers the COMMIT to agent/turn-stopping

recoveryAfterFiveSuccesses.description: 5th clean success in a failure episode commits tool/recovery

attribution.note: Attribution only. Same SQL transaction shape on an isolated DB; NORMAL weakens durability and is NOT a candidate.
attribution.deltaDefinition: median(FULL samples) - median(NORMAL samples), computed from the unrounded arrays

acp.timingNarrow: Parent-process performance.now() between two observation points in this parent process: client-observed tool_call_update (failed/completed) -> next provider HTTP request arrival. It does NOT prove coverage of a collector commit that occurred before the update; use timingFullTurn for coverage. Model generation, network and the end_turn response are outside this attribution window.
acp.timingFullTurn: Parent-process performance.now(): writing the session/prompt JSON-RPC request -> receiving that prompt's JSON-RPC response. Unconditionally contains any synchronous collector commit anywhere in the turn, host tool finalization, the follow-up request and the loopback end_turn response. With the deterministic loopback provider there is no real model inference; host scheduling and IPC are included.
acp.provider: loopback deterministic Anthropic-compatible SSE; no external model calls, no credentials
